text: Based on the evidence, a tree-cover loss candidate of 13.5 hectares was detected in 2025 within the property. However, this detection is pending corroboration, meaning it needs to be confirmed by observations in a later year. No tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or more were detected between 2021 and 2024. Therefore, while there is a potential tree-cover loss event, it has not been confirmed as of the latest data.
